newsitem.title: USA: Colonial unit files for $370 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Colonial unit files for $370 mln in debt.

text.p: Colonial Realty Limited Partnership, a unit of Colonial Properties Trust, said Friday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $370 million in debt securities.
The partnership intends to use the net proceeds for general business purposes, including, without limitation, the development and acquisition of additional properties.

Proceeds will also be used for the repayment of certain debt oustanding at such time, capital expenditures, improvements to certain properties in company's portfolio, working capital and other general corporate purposes.
The company is headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama. Colonial Properties Trust is a real estate investment trust.
